title: .NET
description: .NET projects: NuGet, the .NET downloads and GitHub open, everything else closed.

de.title: .NET
de.description: .NET-Projekte: NuGet, die .NET-Downloads und GitHub offen, alles andere zu.

notes: The SDK (.NET 10): from sandbox-ai's signed toolchains, mounted read-only at /opt/toolchains (nothing to install in the sandbox): sandbox-ai toolchain add dotnet once, then --toolchain dotnet on the command line, or into the running sandbox: sandbox-ai toolchain attach RUN dotnet. Its registries are the ones this preset opens.
Without it: the SDK: Microsoft's dotnet-install.sh (https://dot.net/v1/dotnet-install.sh) into the sandbox's HOME, kept with the start; Debian has no .NET.
Telemetry: set DOTNET_CLI_TELEMETRY_OPTOUT=1 in your environment and pass it with --env DOTNET_CLI_TELEMETRY_OPTOUT (its collector is not opened anyway).
Pushes: a login during the run (sandbox-ai net allow --git-token-env ...) or the push proxy.
